entries.reason: Portfolio.parsedAt: the engine's single wall-clock read, injected by the worker and never read inside parsing (design §4.1).
Same-origin URL for pdfjs CMaps and standard fonts under /pdfjs/ (A24); never a third-party host.
The main-thread side of the worker protocol (design §3.3).
Theme preference `sip-lens.theme` is the only value the app may store (US-19, US-21, CLAUDE.md); reads and writes are wrapped so blocked storage degrades to prefers-color-scheme.

Same-origin load of the bundled synthetic public/sample-cas.pdf for 'Try with a sample CAS' (US-11); the spec's US-20 lists the sample PDF among the permitted static asset loads. Nothing is sent and no other URL is ever fetched.
